module: Flowgraph node "Set Recovery Prompt Enabled" (category once_instant). Enables or disables the standard recovery prompt buttons; a disabled button stays visible but not selectable. Input pins: flipMission, recoverMission (default true), submitMission, restartMission (default false). Depends on gameplay_walk.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the central content of the node in the flowgraph editor (ImGui).

workOnce.desc: For each standard button whose pin is not nil, calls core_recoveryPrompt.setButtonEnabledById.
